New test_llm_cost.py (4 HTTP cases) seeds 3 docs + 1 legacy doc and asserts cost math, $ifNull fallback, 30-day sparkline length, forecast extrapolation, and shape. 31/31 LLM tests pass. 51/51 scripted regression suite (router + scenarios + sandbox_http) still green. Live curl against preview confirms endpoint shape (mtd day 25/30, daily len 30, valid forecast). Frontend Cost Dashboard card renders correctly BELOW LLM Provider card (y=1216 vs y=821): all 5 testids present (cost-dashboard-card, cost-mtd, cost-forecast, cost-calls, cost-sparkline, cost-by-model), SVG sparkline draws 30 <rect> bars, per-model row shows provider badge + name + calls + cost, and the page fires /api/analytics/llm-cost exactly once on mount.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3170 lines — still well past the 700-line guideline. Splitting LLM helpers (call_*, pricing, cost endpoint) into a dedicated module would dramatically improve maintainability. Not blocking.

_cost_for short-circuit logic: `if model.startswith('ollama:')` is checked AFTER stripping the prefix into `m`, which is fine, but the order would matter if anyone later added a 'gemini:' or 'openai:' prefix that isn't in LLM_PRICING — they would silently fall back to Sonnet pricing (DEFAULT_PRICING). Consider an explicit warn-log or whitelist.

days_in_month computation uses `month_start.month % 12 + 1` then subtracts a day — works for Jan-Nov but on December it would replace month=1 (year unchanged), then -1 day yields Dec 31 of the SAME year. Acceptable since calendar.monthrange would be cleaner; current impl is correct but brittle. Mentioned in code review only — does not affect test pass.

Emergent token estimation is heuristic (chars/4). On long system prompts (e.g. KB-stuffed) this typically under-estimates by 20–40% vs real Anthropic tokenization, so forecast may be conservative. Document this on the dashboard tooltip.

The dispatcher logs `model_used == f'anthropic:{model_short}'` for the anthropic path but the model field in by_model parsing splits on ':' → provider becomes 'anthropic'. Consistent ✓. For the Emergent path it logs the bare dated id (no prefix), so provider defaults to 'emergent' in the response — also consistent.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature works end-to-end. Single observation worth flagging to main agent: on the current preview the LLM Cost dashboard shows $0.00 / 32 calls / 0k tokens for instances that have only legacy llm_usage records (pre-tuple refactor). This is *correct* behavior (legacy docs have no input_tokens/output_tokens fields → $ifNull→0→_cost_for=0). Once the bot starts replying again with the new code path, real tokens will start accumulating. The curl-verified $0.0452 / 64 calls for instance 8292460c reflects historical data that includes a handful of post-refactor calls (2898 input + 23 output tokens). No bug.
